body_markdown:
eFax® is traveling to New Orleans for ResMed Connect, bringing together out-of-hospital care leaders, HME providers, and digital health pioneers. As post-acute care ecosystems shift toward connected technology, we’re excited to demonstrate how our cloud fax infrastructure accelerates document exchange across disparate environments.


Stop by to meet the eFax® team and explore how our cloud solutions automate incoming order processing, physician signatures, and referral tracking. With robust data encryption and strict HIPAA compliance, eFax® ensures smooth, secure record transfers between equipment suppliers, clinical teams, and home care providers.


[Learn More](https://events.resmed.com/event/ResmedConnect2026/summary)
